description: List member check-ins (who was on site, when, and via which booking or pass) — useful for occupancy and attendance. OfficeRnD: GET /checkins.

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

started_before.description: Only check-ins starting before this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

started_from.description: Only check-ins starting at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

name: officernd_list_checkins
title: List check-ins
